newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SWEDISH SPARBANKEN EYES LATVIA, LITHUANIA MKTS.
newsitem.headline: SWEDISH SPARBANKEN EYES LATVIA, LITHUANIA MKTS.

text.p: Sparbanken Sverige wants to become active in the Latvian and Lithuanian markets and intends to do this through new Estonian partner Hoiupank (Savings Bank), executive vice-president Lars-Olof Odlund said.
Sparbanken last December bought a 12.5 percent stake in Hoiupank, the second-largest Estonian bank, which it has said it wants to expand to both the Latvian and Lithuanian markets.

"Estonian Savings Bank is considering investments there and we want to establish ourself (in Latvian and Lithuanian markets) through a partner," Odlund told Reuters on Saturday after a Hoiupank shareholder meeting.
Odlund was voted on to the board at the meeting.
Hoiupank has said it wants to start operating in Lithuania this summer and enter Latvia through subsidiaries.
Sparbanken's strategy is to find good partners and start cooperation with them, Odlund added.
"Many of our customers are interested in the Baltics and we want to be able to give them support," he added.
Sparbanken Sverige became Hoiupank's third largest shareholder through its 12.5 percent stake.
"If there is an opportunity, we would increase our stake to 20 percent, but not above that," Odlund said.
